name: What's the difference between battery-powered and wired under-cabinet lighting?
description: Battery-powered lights are easy to install but need battery changes; wired lights are brighter and consistent but require electrical setup.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between battery-powered and wired under-cabinet lighting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Battery-powered under-cabinet lighting offers easy, wire-free installation and portability, making it ideal for renters or areas without easy electrical access. However, it requires frequent battery replacement and typically has lower light output. Wired systems (hardwired or plug-in) provide consistent, brighter illumination without battery changes but require electrical installation. When deciding, consider the practical tradeoff between convenience of installation and long-term maintenance and brightness.
